title: String Reverser
description: Reverse strings using different techniques, reverse words in sentences, and build a palindrome checker.

steps.title: Reverse with built-in methods
steps.description: Write a `reverseString` function that uses `.split()`, `.reverse()`, and `.join()` to reverse a string.
hints: str.split('') converts string to array of characters
arr.join('') converts array back to string

verification.failureMessage: reverseString('hello') should be 'olleh', reverseString('world') should be 'dlrow'.

steps.title: Reverse with a loop
steps.description: Write a `reverseStringLoop` function that reverses a string using a `for` loop (no built-in reverse).
hints: Loop through the string from back to front
Build a new string by adding each character
Or loop forward and prepend each character

codeTemplate.python:
def reverseStringLoop(str):
  reversed = ""
  
  return reversed

print(reverseStringLoop("hello"))
print(reverseStringLoop("abc"))

verification.failureMessage: reverseStringLoop('hello') should be 'olleh', reverseStringLoop('abc') should be 'cba'.

steps.title: Reverse word order
steps.description: Write a `reverseWords` function that reverses the order of words in a sentence (but keeps each word intact).
hints: Split the sentence into words: str.split(' ')

verification.test: output.includes('world hello') && output.includes('fox brown quick the')

steps.title: Reverse each word
steps.description: Write a `reverseEachWord` function that reverses the characters in each word while keeping the word order the same.
hints: Reverse each word individually using your reverseString function
Join the reversed words back with spaces

steps.title: Palindrome using reversal
steps.description: Write an `isPalindrome` function that uses string reversal to check if a string is a palindrome (case-insensitive).
hints: Use reverseString to get the reversed version
Convert both to lowercase before comparing
Also strip spaces and punctuation for robustness

verification.failureMessage: racecar and RaceCar should be true, hello should be false.
